dictionary.lore: A part of Beiorg's armor. Believed to have been made with techniques foreign to Elgaia, this seemingly weightless Item's great durability and elasticity has been drawing the attention of many as a new material. However, it tends to lose its valuable properties when mixed with other ingredients, making it a very difficult material to work with. Much more research is still needed before it can be put to practical use.
